import os, sys, json, hashlib, pathlib, time, gc, threading, traceback
repo=pathlib.Path.cwd()
out=repo/'docs/neural_tube_napari_segmentation_investigation/20260906T065749Z_provenance'
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
for key,sub in [('MPLCONFIGDIR','mpl_cache'),('NUMBA_CACHE_DIR','numba_cache'),('CUDA_CACHE_PATH','cuda_cache')]:
    os.environ[key]=str(out/sub)
os.environ['QT_QPA_PLATFORM']='offscreen'
os.environ['PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE']='1'
os.environ['OMP_NUM_THREADS']='4'
os.environ['NUMBA_NUM_THREADS']='4'
import numpy as np, tifffile
def plain(v):
    if isinstance(v, pathlib.Path): return str(v)
    if isinstance(v, np.ndarray): return v.tolist()
    if isinstance(v, np.generic): return v.item()
    raise TypeError(type(v).__name__)
def save(name, data):
    with (out/name).open('x',encoding='utf-8') as f:
        json.dump(data,f,indent=2,default=plain,allow_nan=False)
def sha(p):
    h=hashlib.sha256()
    with pathlib.Path(p).open('rb') as f:
        for b in iter(lambda:f.read(8*1024*1024),b''): h.update(b)
    return h.hexdigest()
def large_stack(fn):
    result=[]; errors=[]
    def run():
        try: result.append(fn())
        except BaseException: errors.append(sys.exc_info())
    old=threading.stack_size(64*1024*1024)
    t=threading.Thread(target=run); t.start(); t.join()
    threading.stack_size(old)
    if errors: raise errors[0][1].with_traceback(errors[0][2])
    return result[0]
release=repo/'DARE3dv2_Zenodo_040926'
data=repo/'DARE3d_data_190326/Neural_tube_160226'
legacy=data/'weights/segmentation3d_new_set_og/runs/12-01-26'
cfgdir=release/'Neural_tube_160226/weights/segmentation3d_new_set_og/runs/12-01-26'
ckpt=release/'DARE3D_neural_tube_segmentation_epoch057.ckpt'
movies={'movie_I2':(data/'trainingset/movie2/im/movie_I2.tif',data/'trainingset/movie2/label/movie_I2.tif'),
        'movie_M':(data/'test_input/im/movie_M.tif',data/'test_input/label/movie_M.tif')}

prior=repo/'docs/neural_tube_napari_segmentation_investigation/20260905T211815Z'
os.environ['PROJECT_ROOT']=str(repo)
from omegaconf import OmegaConf
OmegaConf.register_new_resolver('eval',eval,replace=True)
from napari_dare3d import _api as api
from dare3d.metrics import object_level as obj
from unittest.mock import patch
from scipy.optimize import linear_sum_assignment
raw=tifffile.memmap(out/'full_native_replay_movie_I2.tif')
prob=np.swapaxes(raw,-1,-3)
truth=np.load(prior/'movie_I2_truth_raw.npy',mmap_mode='r')
print('BEGIN final fixed historical scoring',flush=True); begin=time.perf_counter()
metrics,info=large_stack(lambda:obj.evaluate_at_object_level(prob,truth,.55,.15,distance_mode='iou',distance_threshold=1e-6))
reference=json.loads((prior/'archived_archived.json').read_text())
p=np.asarray(info['pred_ccs_stats']['centroids']);q=np.asarray(reference['pred_centers_txyz'])
cost=np.linalg.norm((p[:,None,:]-q[None,:,:])*np.array([100,1,1,1]),axis=2)
rows,cols=linear_sum_assignment(cost)
save('historical_metric_replay.json',{'metrics':metrics,'archived_metrics':reference['metrics'],'metrics_exactly_equal':metrics==reference['metrics'],'threshold':.55,'min_weighted_prob':.15,'temporal_dilation':True,'matching':'greedy IoU>1e-6','predicted_centers':p,'matched_items':info['matched_items'],'archived_matched_items':reference['matches'],'count':len(p),'archived_count':len(q),'elapsed_seconds':time.perf_counter()-begin,'paired_center_max_abs_txyz':np.max(np.abs(p[rows]-q[cols]),axis=0),'paired_center_mean_abs_txyz':np.mean(np.abs(p[rows]-q[cols]),axis=0),'center_pairs_new_archived':list(zip(rows,cols))})
print('HISTORICAL SCORE',json.dumps(metrics),'n',len(p),'vs',len(q),flush=True)
del info,truth,p,q,cost;gc.collect()
cfg=api._load_inference_cfg(str(cfgdir),str(movies['movie_I2'][0].parent),'cpu',checkpoint_path=str(ckpt))
def extract():
    with patch.object(api,'_build_model',return_value=None),patch.object(api,'_build_dataset',return_value=None),patch.object(api,'segmentation_inference',return_value=[raw]):
        return api._segment(cfg,'cpu',overlap=.5,batch_size=12,threshold=.5,min_weighted_prob=.1)
centers=large_stack(extract)
old=json.loads((prior/'archived_napari_actual_centers.json').read_text())
save('actual_napari_extraction_native.json',{'centers_mtxyz':centers,'count':len(centers),'archived_actual_napari_count':old['n'],'count_matches_archive':len(centers)==old['n'],'threshold':.5,'comparison':'>','min_weighted_prob':.1,'temporal_dilation':False,'note':'Actual current API post-processing executed on cached probabilities; no new model or regression inference.'})
print('ACTUAL NAPARI CENTERS',len(centers),'archived',old['n'],flush=True)
